title: Price increase on school meals will 'acutely' affect children in poverty
summary: The cost of a school dinner for primary and special school pupils will go up by 50p from £2.60 to £3.10.

title: Police call off seperate searches for missing teen boy and another man off two Sydney beaches
summary: Decision comes after six people died along Australia’s eastern coastline during a horror New Year period Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Emergency services have suspended separate searches for a teenage boy and a male swimmer in waters off Sydney amid a horror New Year period on Australian beaches. On Sunday afternoon, New South Wales police said search and rescue operations had been suspended in the search for a 16-year-old boy who was a passenger in a boat that capsized off Palm Beach on New Year’s Eve.
